assumptions: The logo expresses data-informed support; audience interpretation remains a design judgment.
brief.audience: People who want training assistance and data-informed improvement.
brief.name: Reprism

philosophies.statement: Provide a stable reference that supports a person's training.
Summarize repeated records instead of reacting to one isolated observation.
Connect measured differences to an understandable next adjustment.

brief.purpose: Support exercise decisions through measured movement, accumulated records, and interpretable statistical feedback.

rules.statement: Record inputs and statistical gain may change the inner trace but must leave the outer R reference unchanged.
Use an explicitly computed statistical summary to construct the internal curve.
Maintain at least 1px nominal trace weight and curved-lane clearance at a 28px wordmark height.
Label the numerical inputs as illustrative design values, without implying clinical validation or actual exercise outcomes.

rationale.check: Changing records must not change the reference geometry.
rationale.observable_result: A steady outer R supports the internal record.
rationale.rule: Hold the reference frame fixed as observation values and smoothing vary.

rationale.check: Verify the summary independently and that it drives actual curve coordinates.
rationale.observable_result: The inner trace summarizes multiple records rather than tracing raw inputs.
rationale.rule: Use an exponential moving average of an illustrative observation sequence.

rationale.check: Validate target-minus-summary radii, genuine lane clearance, and a readable mono symbol.
rationale.observable_result: The trace approaches its target as the illustrated summary deviation decreases.
rationale.rule: Express differences relative to a fixed target inside the reference envelope.
